limitations: Only one hash-pinned runtime family recognized.
This is a disassembler, not recovery of original BASIC or variable names.
Source lines are user-supplied annotations associated through .W, not authenticated original source.
Initialization/DATA/variable regions are reported as regions, not decoded as p-code.
Line-map final four bytes retained opaque; no zero-sentinel assumption.
Linear code-region listing does not imply all instructions are reachable.
